name: Kamut
siboNotes: Contains high levels of fructans like other wheat varieties, making it unsuitable for SIBO elimination phases. Should be avoided during bacterial overgrowth treatment.
preparationTips: Soaking and fermenting may reduce FODMAP content slightly but won't make it low FODMAP
Can be used in very small amounts as flavoring in mixed dishes
Choose certified organic to avoid glyphosate residues
Store in airtight containers to prevent rancidity
